0022600032.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (6-1, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) carry a three-game winning streak into this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game at the Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West), who are on a two-game winning streak and 4-1 at home. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, 2026.
